lifecycle.realization_logic: The pay is realized if March 2027 SOFR implied stays above cash at 3.90 and extends with the two-year above 4.67.

actions.note: Pay 20 million March 2027 SOFR. The hike continuation is the contract still above cash.

trend-follower.invalidation: The dollar-yen hold ends if the pair falls back inside the pre-breakout range, or if the two-year falls back below 4.67 and March 2027 SOFR implied falls back below 4.53. The new SOFR pay ends on that same hike failure.
trend-follower.thesis: Hold the 10 million dollar-yen long and pay March 2027 SOFR. Dollar-yen at 160 is a five-day upside break and the 96th percentile of five years, so the long opened on 12 November is still with the trend. The hike path underneath it is cash SOFR at 3.90 against March 2027 near 4.60, with the two-year at 4.88 and the ten-year at 5.15. WTI at 88.56 and Brent at 95.84 are lower, and yields and the dollar are still higher.

rates_candidate.rationale: The US ten-year at 5.15 beside Germany at 3.37 and Canada at 3.78 is the policy path, not one mean-reverting contract.

expression_memo.rationale: The euro discount versus sterling is already booked. The listed ten-year gaps are the policy path, not a single convergence instrument.

spot_candidate.rationale: Euro-sterling at 0.8356 is the 3rd percentile of one year and the 11th of five years.

actions.note: Hold the euro-sterling long. The historical discount is intact.

value-guy.invalidation: The euro long is invalidated if euro-sterling stays pinned near 0.834 after euro-dollar and euro-yen have lifted off their lows, or if a renewed rise in crude marks that cheapness as fair.
value-guy.thesis: Hold the five million long euro versus sterling. Euro-sterling at 0.8356 is the 3rd percentile of the past year and the 11th of the past five years. The same euro cheapness is still there against the dollar at 1.1052 and against the yen at 176.83. The US ten-year at 5.15, the German ten-year at 3.37, and the Canadian ten-year at 3.78 are the policy path. They do not name one markable mean-reverting spread. Oil at 88.56 and 95.84 leaves the original crude test unmet.

expression_memo.rationale: March SOFR near 4.60 against cash at 3.90 is a linear rates future. Spot dollar at these extremes is short a snapback. No option premium is quoted.

actions.note: No listed option can be marked. The book stays flat rather than selling the snapback in spot.

vol-convexity.invalidation: The flat book changes when a listed option is quoted with a premium, a strike, and an implied volatility, or when euro-dollar, the kiwi, and dollar-yen leave these extremes so spot dollar is no longer short that snapback.
vol-convexity.thesis: Stay flat. Spot dollar risk here is short a snapback: euro-dollar at 1.1052 and the kiwi at 0.5532 are multi-year lows still breaking down, and dollar-yen at 160 is a five-year extreme still breaking up, next to a two-year at 4.88 and a ten-year at 5.15. That linear long is the wrong shape. No option premium, strike, or implied volatility is quoted, so the book will not pay for convexity it cannot mark and will not open spot just to have a position.
